stem: Rowan Health wants junior engineers to submit changes for review and preview what each would do on their own, while a senior engineer decides what is applied. Which workspace role should the junior engineers' team receive?

choices.text: Write, which can approve and apply plans as part of day-to-day provisioning
Admin, which adds workspace settings on top of the other roles
Read, which lets people view information about workspace runs
Plan, which can queue Terraform plans

rationale: The Plan role is for people who might propose changes to managed infrastructure but whose changes should be approved before they are applied: it can queue Terraform plans but lacks the permission to approve and apply them. Write is the role for day-to-day provisioning and includes approving and applying plans, so juniors could push changes live. Admin builds on every lower role and adds settings access, so it also includes applying. Read is described as "View information about workspace runs," whereas Plan is described as "Queue Terraform plans in the workspace," so Read juniors could look at runs but could not queue plans to preview their own changes.
